import sys


def main():
    raw = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    nl = raw.find(b"\n")
    body = raw[nl + 1:].replace(b"\n", b",").rstrip(b",\r\n")
    sums = {}
    if body:
        t = body.split(b",")
        n = len(t) // 3 * 3
        get = sums.get
        for cat, v in zip(t[1:n:3], map(float, t[2:n:3])):
            sums[cat] = get(cat, 0.0) + v
    out = [cat.decode() + "," + ("%.2f" % sums[cat]) for cat in sorted(sums)]
    sys.stdout.write("\n".join(out) + ("\n" if out else ""))


main()
why: Avoid per-line Python loop: flatten the whole body into one token list and stride over it, so the hot loop is only dict accumulation over zip of slices.
